notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 990M
notes.notes:
- New sound effects
- Better ball rolling physics
- Accumulators slowly discharge when not active
- Moving parts of maps don't stutter anymore on clients
- Fixed wrong in-game menu display when opened by local player 2, 3 or 4
- Tweaked postprocess in some map

notes.title: Patch with in-game emotes and chat!
notes.notes:
Patch 931 release notes:
- Quick chat in-game (including emotes!)
- Chat box in lobby
- Aesthetic improvements of maps
- Cooler explosion dynamics
- Fixed bug that could let players keep firing or hold shield after getting the ball
- More precise time display on clients
- Ball loses charge after two bounces

notes.title: Patch with Skill Skull voice and various fixes
notes.notes:
0.2.880 patch notes:
- Added Skill Skull voice sound
- Fixed bug that could freeze 2nd and 3rd clients at character respawn
- Music tracks should not desynchronize anymore
- Fixed infinite air jump while firing at a certain angle
- “Choose next map” button showed at the end of local matches, and hidden for clients in private matches
